icp: B2B SaaS companies running an outbound sales motion
fit_rule: First-party public page establishes a B2B software product offered to business teams.
signal_rule: First-party company or named founder source explicitly establishes the company itself runs outbound prospecting, publishes its own outbound campaign results, or hires a role to run its outbound sales motion. Product features and customer campaign examples alone do not qualify.
buyer_rule: Revenue/growth/sales operations owner or founder with a public connection to outbound strategy and plausible sending-infrastructure influence. Record inference separately from proven ownership.
recency_rule: Record visible dates; no arbitrary cutoff. Undated or relative-only dates are not recent claims.
constraints: Two distinct net-new contacts; no agency client-service requirement; $0 additional cash; draft only; no imports or CRM/list writes; no installs/reconfiguration; existing agency files untouched.
